findings.text: the margin this table quotes is the route's error divided by one tenth of the density model's own separation from the fan (the summary builds it from the discriminator's sampled_polygon_quadratic_density_fan arm at build_row_summary.py:43-48), which is neither of the two terms the done-when names: the prompt's clause says the second-order coupling frozen-image error where measured and otherwise the fan floor, both of which are smaller on weak 110 (4.6622335696852e-07 of span and 2.9240274730927e-16 relative against the 1.1693910794921578e-06 relative used), and the benchmark's own metric for that clause (finalize(), which applies the floor to every row and reports maximum_budget_ratio) was never executed, so no receipt carries the done-when's own ratio; the record's image row (line 88) does use the coupling term, so the two halves of the same table rest on different term classes.

the exact-density arm and the fan reference it reads zero against are one arithmetic — `_boundary_exact_density_moments` (anchor-triangle tensor Gauss) and the fixture's polygon rule that `_fan_cut_moments` calls produce bitwise-identical points, weights and all three moments when replicated on a synthetic polygon, so the arm's exactly 0.0 and its 0.0 frozen-image delta are identities rather than measurements and cannot fail; the record's attribution that the residual is the density model's fit rather than the arc's representation (evidence line 81, plan line 71) is in fact carried by the separate chord-vs-arc discriminator, which does move the first moments by 2.5e-3.

the order study integrates only the unshifted path (exponent = radial_power + 1, the density antiderivative's line integral, degree five in the edge parameter and exactly the zeroth moment's integrand), while the production's two first-moment paths carry radial_shift and vertical_shift of one (nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py `_monomial_antiderivative`, exponents rp+2 and y**(vp+1)) whose integrand is degree six, where three-point Gauss is inexact; on an asymmetric sliver with a genuinely quadratic flux I measured order-3 relative defects of 2.1e-06 (radial) and 3.5e-06 (vertical) against 3e-16 to 6e-16 at order four, so the receipt field lowest_order_exact_on_the_model_antiderivative: 3 present in all nine receipts generalises a one-path result to the whole model, and the honest statement is the code comment's own — order three is the lowest that meets the budget, not the lowest that is exact.

the field fixture's coefficient is [0.2, 0.3, -0.25, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0], zero in every quadratic slot, so the test's flux is linear in the local coordinates and its density is an exactly representable quadratic polynomial: the degree-four model reproduces it to the last bit and the order-three rule is exact on it by construction, for the same structural reason as the receipt's order study, so this test cannot fail on a quadrature-order or density-model defect and no test in the module exercises a genuinely quadratic flux.

justifications.durability: the module carries tests for the route's accuracy against the fan refinement floor, the fixed 149/472 bound, the six weak cut cells that were previously refused, the empty-arc refusal and the bank-overflow refusal, and the run's committed module logs report 6 passed and 3 passed in separate fresh processes on all_debug with exit 0, but the accuracy test's field fixture (tests/test_exact_clip_moments.py:82) carries zero quadratic flux coefficients, so its density is an exactly representable quadratic and the order-3 rule is exact on it for the same structural reason the receipt's own study is; no test exercises a genuinely quadratic flux, so nothing in the module can fail on a quadrature-order or density-model defect, and the "against base" arm is unmeasured as declared.
justifications.evidence: I re-derived all twenty-seven margins from the nine part receipts and their discriminator receipts and both headline numbers reproduce exactly (tightest 23.330920863734132 on moderate 110 current, widest 1109.4748681235592), the byte-identity claim reproduces bitwise, and the row-table checker's two positive controls both fired in the committed log, which is the discipline this repo asks for; but the term the margin divides by is not either term the done-when names — the summary's `other_error_term` is the density model's own separation from the fan (arms[1].moment_relative_l2_against_fan, 1.1693910794921578e-06 at weak 110), while that row's second-order coupling frozen-image error (4.6622335696852e-07 of span) and its fan refinement floor (2.9240274730927e-16 relative) are both receipted and both smaller — the fan floor is null on eight of the suite's nine rows, the benchmark's own implementation of the done-when metric (`finalize()`, the one-tenth-of-the-fan-floor ratio, benchmarks/exact_clip_moment_floor.py:708) was never run because the fourth case was not requested, and on weak 110, the one row where the floor exists, the route misses one tenth of it by 1.6e8 (4.578e-09 against 2.924e-17).
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's idiom (NamedTuple returns, jnp.where padding, compile-time constants with the basis-rank guard, docstrings stating the mechanism), the mandated naming checks over the eleven touched paths return only hex colour-code false positives, and no plan label, stage name, superseded-name suffix or attribution appears anywhere in the diff or the commit messages.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the locked spline-gauss representation is landed — the clip's own sampled arc as a straight-edge polygon carrying a fixed per-edge Gauss rule at nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py:167 (`_sampled_arc_polynomial_moments`: compile-time arc count, edge capacity and node count, exact-zero padding, orientation read from the traced polygon, no data-dependent branch), the chord-plus-sagitta machinery deleted from the production route, the fixed bound receipted as 149 edges and 472 live evaluations per cut cell, and the default route shown byte-identical to the base revision (moments (3,135) and image equal, max|diff| 0.0, matching sha256); the per-edge order meets the locked budget on all nine rows, which is the decision's actual requirement ("the lowest that meets that budget"), while the exactness clause the receipts attach to that order holds on only one of the three moment paths (see the second finding).
justifications.scope_discipline: `git -C <worktree> diff --name-status ef5504ea..f225e9c0` returns exactly the eleven declared paths (the module, the benchmark, one test file, five figure artifacts and the two documents) with nothing under nova/ outside clip_quadrature.py, and each of the five commits touches only declared paths with a conventional subject, a body, and no attribution trailer.
